Overview

[edit]

The AfreecaTV StarCraft League Remastered Season 14 (ASL Season 14), is an offline tournament organized and broadcast live on AfreecaTV.

Tournament Information

[edit]

Format

[edit]
  • Round of 24 group stage
    • Dual tournament format: Bo1
    • Top two players in each group advance
  • Round of 16 group stage
    • 12 players from the Round of 24 join the four seeds from ASL Season 13
    • Dual tournament format: First two matches: Bo1 - Final three matches: Bo3
    • Top two players in each group advance
  • Elimination Stage
    • Eight player single-elimination bracket
    • Quarterfinals: Bo5
    • Semi-Finals & Finals: Bo7
